summary: Added tiered DAG+RAG retrieval to /search handler in daemon.js and exposed task_key param in mcp-core.js. When task_key is provided, context_deps note nodes are collected from the graph and prepended as tier:"dag"/score:1.0 results (always inject, no gate). RAG scoring runs on the remaining candidates (tier:"rag"), excluding DAG keys. Results are merged with DAG notes first. MCP tool definition updated with optional task_key: {type:"string"} and updated description.
